items.title: Joe Muranyi interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 11, 2007
items.q: I have two grandkids, George and Charles.

ctx.x: Was music a big part of your household when you were young?

Yeah I think so. My parents were musical. They sang and — they didn’t play any instruments, nor in my mother’s family there were a lot of brothers and sisters, they didn’t play anything. But I recently learned that my grandfather, my father’s father, played violin and guitar which was a surprise to me. I barely remember him. But they were always musical, and I always thought that, you know, Hungarians had a natural affinity for music like Italians, Irish, something like that. And in recent years, the past 20…
